services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Michael Jackson
reviews.text: I had my own cats and the guy Joey charged me $150 to install them and kept my old ones for a core! I didn’t owe him a core because i bought my own cats!! I didn’t mind paying $150 for the labor but i wanted my property! He refused to give them to me! Also i have a exhaust leak because he didn’t change out my biscuit! I won’t be going back!

reviews.author: The Cali Rich Network
reviews.text: Came here to get my brakes done. I was in and out and the people were very friendly and helpful. My car drives better than ever. Definitely coming back in the future!!!

reviews.author: Amber Lynn
reviews.text: Excellent service with a timely matter an reasonable price! Chris has not let me down yet, from needing tires to getting the spit an sputter out of my car! He is certainly who I will return to if needed again

reviews.author: x Austin
reviews.text: Wonderful place to go if you don’t care about your vehicle. Got my exhaust don’t there and they wrapped the pipe around my break line, when I confronted them about it I was well within my warranty and they wouldn’t fix it because apparently it was “my fault” r&m muffler is 20x better and it’s just down the road from this place. DO NOT GO TO 701 SERVICE CENTER

reviews.author: Willie Batten
reviews.text: They do good work their! Reasonable prices also ! They are very busy their so that tells people a lot about their work !

reviews.author: Justin cook
reviews.text: Matt is the man. You don't find businesses like this very often nowadays. Great service and down to earth people. Hands down the best muffler shop around.

reviews.author: Tea Bee
reviews.text: Family owned business for decades. Matt, and his father, "Mr. Phil", do a great job, providing quality automotive service, with a focus on exhaust and muffler repair/rebuilds. Glad to give this business the highest rating!

reviews.author: Akelia Cokley
reviews.text: Work is good, prices are reasonable, but they are hardly open and when you call no one ever answer the phone. Had my car for a week haven’t hear anything am whenever I got to check they aren’t open.

reviews.author: Chase “Lakesidejew” Brandt
reviews.text: The place beside service center center is where I take l my vechiles too to get fixed. They are great on prices. And fairly quick.

reviews.author: Emi Lee
reviews.text: Love Love Love this place. Affordable prices for excellent service. This is the only place I’ll be getting my car maintenanced from now on.
